data.description:
## Testing Mode: RED

## What
Write a failing fixture-based test asserting that when detect-session-leakage detects a second push to story/<id>, the ci-llm-review-runner.sh (via the runner) reads prior attestations from a defense fixture file.

## Test file: tests/workflows/test-sprint-story-review-defenses.sh

## Tests to write
1. test_runner_reads_prior_defenses_when_fixture_present
   - Given: a diff fixture at /tmp/story-diff.patch AND a prior-defense fixture at a known path
   - When: ci-llm-review-runner.sh is invoked with DSO_CI_REVIEW_DIFF_PATH=/tmp/story-diff.patch DSO_CI_REVIEW_DRY_RUN=1 DSO_CI_REVIEW_PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH=<fixture-path>
   - Then: runner exits 0 (accepts the env var without error)

2. test_workflow_sets_prior_defenses_path_env
   - Given: sprint-story-review.yml exists
   - When: YAML is inspected
   - Then: run step for ci-llm-review-runner.sh has DSO_CI_REVIEW_PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH env reference (grep for 'DSO_CI_REVIEW_PRIOR_DEFENSES_PATH')

## Files to modify
- tests/workflows/test-sprint-story-review-defenses.sh (CREATE)
- chmod +x the test file
